description: Generate AWS Step Functions ASL state machine with error handling, parallel branches, map states, wait states, and choice states — plus IAM role and CloudFormation template

comment.description: Human-readable description embedded in the ASL definition

startAt.description: Name of the first state to execute (defaults to first state name)

states.description: State definitions — each with type (Task/Choice/Parallel/Map/Wait/Pass/Succeed/Fail), next, catch, retry

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum execution duration in seconds (STANDARD: up to 31536000)

name: generate_step_functions_workflow
